title: Advocates Act, 1961 — Section 37 (Appeal to the Bar Council of India)

content.overview: Section 37 provides an appeal to the Bar Council of India against an order of the disciplinary committee of a State Bar Council.
content.glance: Section 37 provides an appeal to the Bar Council of India against an order of the disciplinary committee of a State Bar Council.
content.study: Any person aggrieved by an order of the disciplinary committee of a State Bar Council made under section 35, or the Advocate-General of the State, may within sixty days prefer an appeal to the Bar Council of India.

sections.body: Section 37 provides an appeal to the Bar Council of India against an order of the disciplinary committee of a State Bar Council.
